_note: Confirmed by management 8 Oct 2026 (sales & pricing policy Oct 2026). Site-wide pricing rules; per-room base_price lives in rooms.json.
price_basis: board rate — per night, incl. VAT; room-only plan unless the rate plan says breakfast is included
display_reason: Decision 24 Oct 2026 (phase 2a): no price is baked into the site; the booking form and the room pages read prices from Supabase at runtime (quote_stay / room_from_prices) while a branch's show_prices switch is on. Static output stays price-free as under the 9 Oct hidden mode; base_price in rooms.json is the seed of the dashboard base rate.
display_ar: السعر حسب التاريخ — اختر تواريخك في نموذج الحجز
display_en: Price depends on your dates — choose them in the booking form

breakfast.addon_unit: per person per day, VAT included
breakfast.display_rule: Decision 9 Oct: no breakfast price next to room prices; the FAQ and /policies/ state it, generated from Settings (site_fees: breakfast_adult, breakfast_child_tiers — Ahmed, 15 Nov 2026). This file is only the fallback of a build without Settings.
breakfast.child_tiers_note: Settings → breakfast.child_tiers (Ahmed, 15 Nov 2026): up to the first max_age free, up to the next its price, above the last the adult price. The texts are generated from these values ({breakfast_free_age}, {breakfast_child_age}, {breakfast_child}), never typed.
breakfast.site_line_en: Breakfast: optional, chosen when you book

extra_bed_note: Confirmed by Ahmed 23 Oct 2026: SAR 50 per extra bed per night, covering whoever sleeps on it; room types allow 0–2 (rooms.json → extra_beds_max). The extra-person fee (25/night) and its children ladder are abolished.

1_starting_from.rule: site shows base_price as «يبدأ من»; reception confirms the final price on booking

2_rate_calendar.rule: admin rate calendar: reception sets price per day per room type; site reads price for the selected dates

3_channel_manager.rule: channel manager syncs rates + availability with Booking.com and other platforms; «يبدأ من» dropped, real price per date shown

rate_plans._note: Breakfast lives on the rate plan, never on the room. Each room lists which plans it sells with that plan's base_price. Phase 2 `rates` rows carry rate_plan_code. Phase 1: only room_only is rendered; breakfast shown as an add-on «الإفطار {breakfast} للشخص في اليوم» (from Settings). bed_and_breakfast is defined for phase 2 (rate calendar) and carries no prices yet.

breakfast.addon_label_ar: الإفطار: يُحدَّد شموله أو رسومه عند تأكيد الحجز
breakfast.addon_label_en: Breakfast: included or charged depending on your booking — confirmed with your reservation
